behavior: The API serves 10k users without hammering the chain or the database
acceptance: Balance reads share one chain read per (chain, wallet, finalized block) with a short cache and request coalescing behind a small interface that a Redis implementation could replace later; balance-history reuses it; ledger_transactions gets an index on invoice_id; the DB pool size is configurable; per-user rate limits answer 429 with Retry-After; the web backs off on 429

A load test in the repo (no paid service) simulating many signed-in users polling every 15 s reports p50/p95 and RPC calls per second before and after; the numbers are recorded in docs/backend with the deployment model (stateless API replicas behind a load balancer, one worker and one signer)
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: PASS after one fix. Balance cache: key covers chain, token, wallet and block; errors not kept; first caller's cancel does not fail waiters (WithoutCancel, deadline kept); memory bounded by keys per minute. Migrate strips only pool_ params. Web 429 backoff cannot loop; tests meaningful. Transport keeps dial/TLS timeouts. Load test compares like with like. FIXED: per-IP limit trusted the client's X-Forwarded-For (Next's rewrite does not set it), so honest payers shared one bucket and a forger was never limited; removed the per-IP limit and the one-implementation limiter interface, public routes are to be limited at the edge (api.md, D-72). Re-verified: verify F107 passed 9 checks.

proof.1: backend: internal/balance TestReadsAreSharedUntilTheFinalizedBlockMoves (20 concurrent reads of one wallet make 1 eth_getBlockByNumber and 1 eth_call at the Anvil proxy; another wallet shares the block read; after the finalized block moves the next read returns the new block and balance), TestFailedReadIsNotKept, TestReadOutlivesTheRequestThatStartedIt; cache behind the small balance.cache interface (memoryCache now, Redis later); /balance-history reads through the same ChainReader.Read; migration 00011 index ledger_transactions_invoice (TestMigrationsRollBackAndReapply up/down/up); TestPoolSizeFromTheURL (pool_max_conns in DATABASE_URL sizes the pool and Migrate no longer sends it to Postgres; reproduced failing first); httpapi TestUserRateLimit (429 rate_limited with Retry-After per Privy user, other users unaffected, passes again after Retry-After; public routes are limited at the edge, api.md); chain TestCallsReuseConnections; unit: apps/web src/shared/api/rate-limit.test.ts (waits Retry-After then retries once; read pause starts at 15 s, doubles to the 5 min cap while retries are refused, ends on success; mutations never held)
proof.2: backend: pnpm --filter @forwend/backend loadtest (e2e/load_test.go, Anvil + proxy + Postgres, no paid service), recorded in docs/backend/architecture.md#load-test with the D-72 deployment model (stateless api replicas behind a load balancer, one worker, one signer, Redis next): 1,000 users before p50/p95 3.4/11.8 ms, 533 RPC calls/s; after 3.7/9.4 ms, 134 RPC/s; 10,000 users before collapsed (p50 40 s, 170,918 of 211,410 requests failed, 6,305 of 12,842 balances unread, 5,333 RPC/s asked); after 1.1/2.4 ms, 0 errors, 1,333 RPC/s (block every 12 s) or 334 RPC/s (block every 60 s); EXPLAIN /balances 21.5 ms -> 0.37 ms with the index; docs-check: links and D-72 valid
